audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits a 48.73% WR lane: Hwei owns 1-2 on raw Q-spellbook range, Vex swings it from 3 with W+Q burst, first item is a coin flip, Vex edges late if she lands E first. Content layer states this; full chart did not.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content spikes carry wrong sub-ability names: 'QE (Devastating Fissure)' — QE is Molten Fissure; 'EE (Gathering Storm)' — fabricated, EE is Crushing Maw; 'EQ (Molten Fissure)' as self-peel — EQ is Grim Visage (the fear), Molten Fissure is QE.
audit.why: Riot kit lists Q subjects as Devastating Fire/Severing Bolt/Molten Fissure and E subjects as Grim Visage/Gaze of the Abyss/Crushing Maw, in QQ/QW/QE and EQ/EW/EE order.
audit.corrected: All three sub-ability names corrected in spikes[0] and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks a fabricated ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, cooldowns, feeding, a Do's bullet and four report entries — the real CC palette is Subject: Torment (E), 12s at rank 1. Full chart was blanket 'Skill' vs content/packet Hwei-Hwei-Vex-Vex-Vex-Skill-Vex. tradeGood/tradeBad were dash-keyed against a champion with no dash. Cooldowns had no digit; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted trade strings.
audit.why: Hwei's kit has no dash, so Vex's mark/fear-on-dash economy is irrelevant; the lane runs on his palette cooldowns (Q 10-6s, E 12-10s, W 18-16s) and stationary cast windows.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name replaced everywhere it appears; chart aligned with grounded whys; trades regrounded in palette-cooldown windows; E 12s and R 120/100/80s added.
